name: Securities Option 88
definition: Specifies securities quantities for corporate action instruction.

ConditionalQuantity.name: Conditional Quantity
ConditionalQuantity.definition: Minimum quantity of securities to be accepted (used in the framework of conditional privilege on election). In case of proration, if this minimum quantity is not reached then the instruction is void.

InstructedQuantity.name: Instructed Quantity
InstructedQuantity.definition: Quantity of securities to which this instruction applies.

AdditionalRoundUpQuantity.name: Additional Round Up Quantity
AdditionalRoundUpQuantity.definition: Quantity of additional shares requested due to the difference of “round-up against payment” practice between the account servicer and the account holder (for instance for French dividend option).
